name: Pricing
description: Three-tier pricing with a highlighted recommended plan, feature lists, and CTAs.

name: Popup promo
description: A modal promotion built on the native <dialog> element. It opens over a dimmed backdrop and closes on the ✕ or a backdrop click.

name: Gallery
description: A responsive thumbnail grid with hover captions. Click any tile to open it in a lightbox.

name: Tabs
description: Tabbed panels that swap content in place. Click a tab to switch.

name: Folders
description: A collapsible file tree built from nested <details>. Folders expand and collapse with no JavaScript.

name: Toggle content
description: A switch that reveals or hides a block of content. CSS-only, using :has().

name: FAQ, expanded by default
description: The accordion pattern with every item open on load (open attribute set). Collapse any you don't need.

name: Contact form
description: A labelled form with focus states and a demo submit (no backend attached).

name: Breadcrumbs
description: A path trail showing the visitor's location, with the current page un-linked.
